method: Authored individual operational advice from property-access questions and official local context. Official sources searched with both available engines. Directly readable pages were inspected; indexed-only records and retrieval limits are stated per source. No source establishes company performance, fleet availability, customer demand or completed work.
operationalScope: Collections originate in Scotland; destinations may be anywhere in Britain. Vehicle, crew, schedule, access and optional preparation remain subject to the actual enquiry.
limitations: No search volumes or local job history were supplied. No driver count or availability has been inferred.
Historic conservation appraisals and the 2017 Angus study establish physical context only; do not use their dated parking, footfall, retail or demographic figures as current facts.
Current loading, permissions, roadworks and private access must be checked for the actual property and moving date.
Postcodes are deliberately empty rather than assigning unsupported area-wide prefixes. Place schema is used for all 32 records.
Some Stirling, Perth & Kinross and Historic Environment Scotland pages returned 403 on direct open; limited indexed statements are identified below. No access restriction was bypassed.
